rationale_bullets: A third-year returning starter (McCown: 71.9 on 450 dropbacks, 48th-pctile as-played) with an explicit health caveat - sports-hernia surgery limited his spring, and 2025 was injury-nagged (Athlon).
Athlon's ceiling framing is attributed ('one of the top signal-callers in the Group of 6 if he can avoid the injuries'); the new OC wants tempo + downfield shots around him.
55 = above average: proven multi-year starter, health-capped.
The breakout returns young: Henderson (year-1) - 866 yds, 6 TD, PFF 85.1 on 125 attempts; Cal's High arrives as the framed impact transfer; Henry (74.2/152) expired.
Proxy's 88 over-extrapolates a 125-attempt sample; the OL in front is the room's constraint.
58 = above average: elite young grade at modest volume + credible depth.
Two standouts + the TE return from a 75th-pctile room (Amador 71.4/270 - yr-2; Wilson 66.3/237; Overmyer 76.2/212 - yr-2); the ceiling piece was poached by Ohio State (McCuin 77.7/322).
Adds are P4-depth with pedigree (West-TT, Madison-Mizzou) in a scheme now built for downfield shots.
52 = average-plus: strong returning base, star gone, QB health linked.

The offense's documented weak link: 26th-pctile as-played with a 47.6-graded 836-snap LT (Missouri) returning; Rios (56.4/786), Marshall (66.3/631), D.Jones (57.0/614) return around a new LG (Athlon).
Adds are P4-backup/G5 (Henry-OkSt, Kebe-Ohio, Senegal-CSU); 'expectations are high' in Athlon's text is offense-wide, not line-specific - the disconfirmation stands.
30 = bottom-third.
7th-pctile as-played AND raided: Ozowalu (74.5) to Oklahoma, Otutu to Cincinnati, Wimberly to Baylor, J.Jones (74.5) expired.
Returns are young rotation (Anyanwu 63.4/278 - yr-2, Buxton 62.7/275, Shaw 59.0/397 - yr-2); adds are quantity (TT pair, UL's Fite, BG's Acheampong, UTEP's Baldwin).
22 = bottom-sixth: the youth is the only argument above the FIU line.
Banks (69.4/713) expired; what returns is mid-volume quality (Tucker 72.1/302 - yr-3; Walley 71.3/165) plus Cal's Osondu; Blackshire's status is unverified (logged).
As-played 17th pctile; LB caution both directions.
30 = bottom-third: two decent grades at partial volume.
Wyrick anchors (78.3 on 676 - year-2, the defensive centerpiece) but the room thinned: Milton expired, BOTH corners poached (Martin-Texas Tech, Meier-Cincinnati).
Rodgers (63.7/301) is the top returning CB; adds are LSU depth (Rogers) + FCS/D2 priors; as-played was 20th pctile with the departed corners.
28 = bottom-third: one excellent young safety, rebuilt everything else.
Athlon's claim is unambiguous: 'UTSA returns all of last year's primary options on special teams' (P Chambers -> SFA the known exception); proxy's 16 is a membership artifact.
2025 SPEC was 66.8 (mid-tier) - continuity of an average group, not a strength.
52 = average-plus on returning continuity.
